تفتدوا (form VIII)
# تَفْتَدُوا (taftadū) /taf.ta.duː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَدَى (iftadā)
# تُفْتَدَوْا (tuftadaw) /tuf.ta.daw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَدَى (iftadā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
